context:
Goal: one name for an agent whose job is to argue against another agent's verdict.
Problem (rule): the GLOSSARY.md row for "refuter" names only the agent that reads a plan, so agents that argue against other verdicts have no term.
Based on (ruling): on Nov 6, 12:43 CST, you asked for one word for any agent that argues against another agent's verdict, and at 13:08 CST you picked "refuter".
Based on (read): commit 1619cf09e renamed "challenger" to "refuter" on main, and GLOSSARY.md line 83 names only the plan-reading agent.
Departs from: main, where the row names only the plan-reading agent — a widens the row to any such agent.
Meanwhile: a small records PR fixes the stale "challenger" row name and a stale Risks line in docs/plans/debate-model-tiers.md.

options.gain: One word for every such agent.
options.how: The row covers any agent that argues against another agent's verdict; the plan refuter is one case.
options.label: Any agent that argues back
options.lose: The row is broader, so each use needs its context.

options.gain: The word keeps one narrow meaning.
options.how: No change: the row names only the agent that reads a plan.
options.label: Plan reader only
options.lose: Other agents that argue back still have no term.
